title: One cached result of a Milestone F token-workbench action
description: Cache-by-identity entry for an expensive token-workbench action (currently: causal_trace), stored on the run under token_workbench_actions so a repeat request with the same run identity + token index + method version + request params + worker identity is a cache hit, never a recompute. `result` is the underlying producer's own artifact (e.g. clozn.analysis.tracer.trace()'s receipt), embedded verbatim -- this schema never reshapes it into a new vocabulary.
